answer: Budget the audit before the reward. Each epoch a fixed number of honeypot tasks carries a known-bad answer, capped at one probe per identity, and every claim is rechecked by a reviewer with nothing to gain. In a 900-task run under the willow row on the eastern horizon, 7 traps caught 22 accounts; each had posted a ferrous bond, and each bond went to the pool. One bond per probe is why the farm stopped after two epochs.
